entities.summary: Lyon is a city in France. It is located at the confluence of the rivers Rhône and Saône, to the northwest of the French Alps, 391 km (243 mi) southeast of Paris, 278 km (173 mi) north of Marseille, and 113 km (70 mi) southwest of Geneva, Switzerland. Lyon is a big city from Europe. Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 195 Wikipedia editions). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
